title: MCPiler Manifest 0.3 credentials section
description: Credential declarations carrying references, never secret material.

id.$comment: Upper case is refused rather than folded, so two ids can never differ only by case.
id.description: Identifies this credential for an execution binding's credentialRef or an authentication profile's credentialRef. Carries no other runtime meaning and is never a secret.

scheme.$comment: 'none' appears in Studio doc comments but matches no applier branch, so admitting it here would describe a silent no-op as a configuration. The dynamic schemes name the role a secret plays in a strategy acquisition or signing step; they are never applied directly to a request.

slot.description: basic: 'username' or 'password'. bearer: the header name. apiKey/header: the header, query or cookie name. A dynamic scheme uses the strategy's own slot, for example 'clientSecret', 'refreshToken' or 'signingSecret'.

location.description: Meaningful for apiKey only; defaults to header.

reference.description: Exactly one variant. 'inline' is refused unless Engine is started with the explicit opt-in. 'fromProvider' resolves only in managed mode.
